description: A shell script for testing Git atomic push functionality, including setup, various push scenarios, hook testing, and failure cases.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Creates a pair of repositories 'upstream' and 'workbench' with specific configurations.

methods.name: test_refs
methods.description: Compares two refs in upstream and workbench repositories to verify they are identical.

methods.name: fmt_status_report
methods.description: Formats the output of push status reports for easier reading.
